senses.gloss: स्तृंह r. 6th cl. (-स्तृंहति) To hurt, to injure, to kill.

स्तृ r. 5th cl. (स्तृणीति स्तृणुते)
 1. To cover, to clothe, to spread on or
over, to strew.
 2. To kill. (-स्तृणोति)
 1. To love.
 2. To protect. With
वि prefixed, 1. To spread widely, to extend.
 2. To diffuse or
prolix.
 3. To cover. With उप, To arrange. With परि, 1. To spread.
2. To cover.
 3. To arrange.

स्तॄ r. 9th cl. (-स्तृणाति स्तृणीते) To clothe, to cover, to spread on or over
more properly ष्टॄ.

स्तृणत् mfn. (-णन्-णती-णत्) Strewing, spreading over or upon, covering.
 E. स्तृ to strew, शतृ aff.
स्तृह् (ऊ) स्तॄहू r. 6th cl. (-स्तृहति) To hurt, to kill; also स्तॄह् and ष्टृह्.
स्तॄह् (ऊ) स्तॄहू r. 6th cl. (स्तॄहति) To hurt or kill: see स्तृह् ।
